items.note: Admissions to shows for 5,000 or more. Up another 20.37% in H1 2026.

components.title: Over half of all box office

footnote: Sources: CAPA 2025 annual brief (Jan 2026), H1 2026 figures (Jul 2026), CAPA and Dengta Pro report (Apr 2025)
notes: Why live shows. Shows with 5,000 or more seats, which means stadium and arena concerts and festivals, drew 43.39 million admissions in 2025, up 18.81%, and took RMB 32.45 billion at the box office, up 9.49%. Dividing by China's total live-show box office of RMB 61.66 billion gives about 52.6%, so big live shows are now the core of the market. The first half of 2026 is growing faster still: 23.28 million admissions, up 20.37%, and RMB 17.11 billion, up 17.70%. We sell drinks, so we count people rather than tickets, and that is the number on this page. Note that CAPA restated its 2025 national figures on a comparable basis, so admissions from different years should not be joined into one trend line.
